description: This file defines the 'Allergy' entity class in a medical records system, representing a patient's allergy record including allergen details, severity, reactions, comments, and associated patient and encounter information.

classes.name: Allergy
classes.description: Represents an allergy record for a patient, including allergen, severity, reactions, comments, encounter, and related metadata.

methods.name: getAllergyId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the allergy record.

methods.name: setAllergyId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the allergy record.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the allergy ID, overridden from OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the allergy ID, overridden from OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves the associated patient.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the associated patient.

methods.name: getAllergenType
methods.description: Gets the type of allergen.

methods.name: setAllergenType
methods.description: Sets the allergen type using an AllergenType enum.

methods.name: setAllergenType
methods.description: Sets the allergen type using a string, parsed to AllergenType.

methods.name: getAllergen
methods.description: Retrieves the Allergen object.

methods.name: setAllergen
methods.description: Sets the Allergen object.

methods.name: getSeverity
methods.description: Gets the severity concept.

methods.name: setSeverity
methods.description: Sets the severity concept.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves the comments.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets the comments.

methods.name: getReactions
methods.description: Returns the list of allergy reactions.

methods.name: setReactions
methods.description: Sets the list of reactions.

methods.name: addReaction
methods.description: Adds a new reaction to the allergy.

methods.name: removeReaction
methods.description: Removes a reaction from the allergy.

methods.name: getDateLastUpdated
methods.description: Returns the date when the allergy was last updated.

methods.name: hasSameValues
methods.description: Checks if this allergy has the same values as another allergy.

methods.name: hasSameReactions
methods.description: Checks if this allergy has the same reactions as another.

methods.name: getAllergyReaction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific AllergyReaction by its ID.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies all properties from another allergy object to this one, excluding IDs and UUIDs.

methods.name: getReactionConcepts
methods.description: Private helper method to get all reaction concepts.

methods.name: getReactionNonCoded
methods.description: Returns non-coded reaction string from reactions.

methods.name: getReaction
methods.description: Gets an allergy reaction matching a specific concept.

methods.name: hasSameAllergen
methods.description: Checks if this allergy has the same allergen as another allergy.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Returns the associated encounter.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the associated encounter.
